video_title: We DEBATE if it's time for New York to make a MAJOR MOVE

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on Mikal Bridges' defensive value and shooting struggles
quotes.excerpt: Mikal Bridges is up there with Sarr Thompson. If he's up there with him, and they can sit him.
quotes.quote: I'm just going to say this briefly. That's exactly what I said about the Detroit Pistons. He can do something that they can't. If old boy decides to put in shooters instead of, and like I said, Sarr Thompson is the motherfucker on the defensive end. But Mikal Bridges is up there with Sarr Thompson, right? If he's up there with him, and they can sit him defensively, he's not shooting the ball well, so it's hard to play him.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva questions if it is time to trade for upgrades
quotes.excerpt: Is it time to make a trade? So now you can pay Karl-Anthony Towns and Josh Hart?

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: With all this happening now, and if this continues to go on, is it time to make a trade? So now you can pay Karl-Anthony Towns and Josh Hart?

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: You got to pay Karl-Anthony Towns, because Karl-Anthony Towns has been on the fucking tear. This man is a double-double every night.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: And Josh Hart might be the one, because you heard what he just said. It's hard to find minutes for Mikal Bridges and Josh Hart.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on Mike Brown's rotation and player development
quotes.excerpt: Mike Brown has changed my whole thought process of him as a coach.
quotes.quote: This is the issue though. For me, the toughest part about this is one, Mike Brown has changed my whole thought process of him as a coach, because he didn't go out there and say, I'm not giving up on these guys, but I got to play these guys as hoopers. For sure. Because there's one thing you can't say. As NBA players, there are ebbs and flows to this season. He's like, fuck that, I'm keeping my job. I'm keeping my job. But at the same time, Mikal Bridges is proven, Josh Hart are proven. I'm not giving up on y'all guys, but y'all got to turn this quarter or the minutes got to go down a little bit until y'all get back get back going.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the necessity of keeping Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: If there's anyone that's going to have to go, it's going to be Josh Hart.
quotes.quote: I'm going to say this. I'm going to say this. If there's anyone that's going to have to go, it's going to be Josh Hart. Because there is zero chance you let Karl-Anthony Towns walk out that door. I don't need you experimenting with no other team. I don't need you thinking about going somewhere else. I don't want you to be unhappy. You have to pay him.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Raymond Felton on the unlikelihood of trading Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.excerpt: New York Knicks would never trade Karl-Anthony Towns. They shouldn't, and I hope they never do.
quotes.quote: Let me say this before I even make this statement. New York Knicks would never trade Karl-Anthony Towns. They shouldn't, and I hope they never do. Would you do Jalen Brunson for Karl-Anthony Towns and Josh Hart?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson on the Dallas Mavericks' contract offer to Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: It was four-year 54 at Christmas time. He was ready to sign it.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson was about to sign for, I think it was 45, 55 million. It was four-year 54 at Christmas time. He was ready to sign it. They said, we going to wait a little bit. Guess what? They got outbid. You better not do it. Get it done.
